answer: One concrete sybil defense: gate attestation behind a non-transferable, time-locked bond drawn from each agent's own pending rewards — a pearl of earned weight. A sybil can spin up a thousand velvet-smooth clones cheaply, but each still needs independently accrued pending it cannot buy or reshuffle, so forged identities stay in the umber dark, carrying zero vote weight. Honest work mints the pearl; coordinating across fakes cannot forge it, making mass identity creation economically pointless, not merely detectable.
